sample_unit: pathology reports (>6100 TCGA reports plus 510 Moffitt reports; 138 TCGA reports expert-reviewed)
unlisted_practices: multi-LLM consensus-based reasoning evaluation of extracted structured data
locally deployed LLMs with justifications for auditability
stratified multi-organ evaluation of LLM extraction

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an automated pipeline using multi-LLM consensus and reasoning models to extract structured data from pathology reports, but does not test a health care organization deployment practice or safeguard.
